name: @gaiadesk/sdk
description: Drive GaiaDesk desks from TypeScript and Node.js: devices, exec, shell, file copy, background jobs, stats, scoped tokens and MCP, through GaiaDesk's native library (@gaiadesk/sdk-native) or gaiadesk-cli.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run typecheck:examples && node --test dist-test/args.test.js dist-test/errors.test.js dist-test/results.test.js dist-test/mcp.test.js dist-test/client.test.js dist-test/native.test.js dist-test/native-real.test.js dist-test/package.test.js
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
